content: PostgreSQL uses MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control) to allow readers and writers to operate without blocking each other.
Redis supports pub/sub messaging for simple fan-out scenarios without a dedicated message broker.
Kafka provides durable partitioned event logs with consumer groups for scalable event processing.
Elasticsearch is a distributed search engine built on Lucene, designed for full-text search and analytics.
We decided to use pgvector instead of a dedicated vector database because our scale fits within Postgres and keeps operations simple.
The Raft consensus algorithm elects a leader among replicas and replicates log entries. Used by etcd and CockroachDB.
Exponential backoff with jitter prevents thundering herd problems. AWS recommends full jitter: sleep = random(0, min(cap, base * 2^attempt)).
CRDTs allow concurrent updates on different replicas without coordination. G-Counters, OR-Sets, and LWW-Registers are common types.
The actor model encapsulates state within actors that communicate via asynchronous messages. Erlang/OTP and Akka implement it.
Circuit breakers prevent cascading failures by stopping requests to a failing service. States are closed, open, and half-open.
Python's GIL prevents true parallel execution of Python bytecodes. Use multiprocessing or asyncio for parallelism.
Rust's ownership system prevents data races at compile time without garbage collection.
Go channels provide typed conduits for goroutine communication. Unbuffered channels synchronize sender and receiver.
TypeScript discriminated unions use a shared literal property to narrow types.
React's useEffect runs after render. The dependency array controls when it re-runs.
FastAPI uses Pydantic for request validation and type hints for automatic OpenAPI schema generation.
Docker multi-stage builds reduce image size by separating build and runtime stages.
Kubernetes liveness probes detect unhealthy pods. Readiness probes control traffic routing.
We chose Docker Compose over Kubernetes for the MVP because the team is small and deployment complexity would slow us down.
N+1 query bug was caused by fetching tags one-by-one. Fixed by adding selectinload(Memory.tags).
